judgement.reason: Homepage is a stateless-capable Next.js dashboard whose YAML config can be baked into the image, so a contained change suffices.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (HOMEPAGE_CONFIG_DIR (runtime source)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: No shown line proves that the configuration directory named by HOMEPAGE_CONFIG_DIR is replaced by a supported datastore or holds only disposable data, so the vendor should confirm whether config files must persist or can be baked into the image.
